description.b: Let's load a set of example projects so we can explore some pre-built-projects models.

item.title: Download AMF Examples Team Project File
item.description: Using your web browser, download the following file to any location on your hard drive: http://eclipse.org/amp/project-sets/escapeAMFExamples.psf.

item.title: Import Project Set
item.description: We'll use the team project set wizaard to import the example from the AMP website. Open the wizard, browse to the location you just downlaoded the file to, and click Finish. The examples will be loaded from the Eclipse CVS server into your workspace.

item.title: Allow project to build
item.description: We can take a look at the progress bar to see the project build. When the progress bar goes away you can continue with the next cheat sheet category.
